node.title: Re^4: How to test for empty hash?
node.author: eyepopslikeamosquito
node.doctext:
Impressive analysis!

It doesn't surprise me there are subtle differences. I only mentioned secret operators for some light relief, and (unlike [BooK] ;), would never inflict the inchworm secret operator on my workmates in production code ... [id://744932|my rule number one] at work being "Correctness, simplicity and clarity come first. Avoid unnecessary cleverness".

Curiously, your second example seems to be fixed by adding use integer: $ perl -le 'print ~~$#foo' 18446744073709551615 $ perl -Minteger -le 'print ~~$#foo' -1

... which reminds me of [id://11135535|this recent reply] by [BillKSmith] ... while typing -Minteger from the command line just now [id://11133051|reminded me] of [chromatic]'s comical -Modern::Perl command line hack. :)

Update: See also: the "Inchworm" and "Inchworm on a stick" sections at [mod://perlsecret] and [id://437032] (search for inchworm).
